entities.name: Hyacinth of Poland
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hyacinth was a Polish Dominican priest and missionary who worked to reform the women's monasteries in his native Poland. Educated in Paris and Bologna, he was a Doctor of Sacred Studies.
